findings.claim: 前十大客戶自 2023 年起每年約占淨銷售 20%–25%；FY2025、FY2024、FY2023 均無單一客戶占合併淨銷售 10% 以上。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 8 Concentration of Credit Risk
findings.excerpt: The Company’s top ten customers have contributed between approximately 20% and 25% of net sales annually since 2023. None of the Company’s customers individually accounted for 10% or more of consolidated net sales in the years ended December 27, 2025, December 28, 2024, and December 30, 2023.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：大客戶可能利用議價地位要求更多促銷等措施而壓低毛利率，失去任一大客戶可能對業務、財務與營運結果造成重大不利影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Our large customers may also seek to leverage their position to improve their profitability through increased promotional programs or other measures, which could have a negative impact on our gross margin. Additionally, the loss of any large customer could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
